international.title: ‘Orwellian’: HIV scientist’s ordeal lays bare Trump officials’ interference in grant-making
international.summary: Researchers forced to scrap original studies as NIH rethinks grants not in ‘alignment’ with administration’s priorities Dr Jade Pagkas-Bather received her first grant from the National Institutes of Health (NIH) in June 2025 – a milestone in any researcher’s career. She planned to study basic income as a medical intervention: her randomized control trial would test whether monthly grants of $500-cash helped poor, HIV-positive young people in Chicago stick with treatment. Her hypothesis was as straightforward as it was cutting. Continue reading...
